zeilen_a.population: Idiopathic Parkinson's Disease (IPD) patients with sleep problems
zeilen_a.direction: higher score indicates worse sleep quality (improvement indicated by reduction, but text reports mean change favoring melatonin as positive difference in improvement magnitude)
zeilen_a.quote: The mean change in Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI) score between the two groups was 1.87 (95 % CI: 1.5–2.1; p = 0.001) and Epworth Sleepiness Scale (ESS) score was 1.25 (95 % CI: 0.80–1.71; p = 0.001) favoring melatonin.
